description: This file defines the class `Smarty_Internal_Method_RegisterFilter`, which provides methods for registering filters within the Smarty templating engine. It includes functions for validating filter types, generating filter names, and registering filter callbacks.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Method_RegisterFilter
classes.description: Provides methods to register and validate filters in the Smarty templating engine, including managing filter types and filter callback functions.

methods.name: registerFilter
methods.description: Registers a filter function for a specified filter type, validating the filter type and ensuring the callback is callable, then stores it in Smarty's registered filters.

methods.name: _getFilterName
methods.description: Generates a string name for a filter callback, using class and method names for array callbacks or the string itself for string callbacks.

methods.name: _checkFilterType
methods.description: Validates that the provided filter type is among the allowed types; throws an exception if invalid.
